data.body: **[P2] Defer abandonment decisions for parents that can still finish.** If a callback completion is queued when a terminal invocation begins cleanup, this condition immediately reparents it to `Workflow` whenever its context remains open. That context can still finish and export its real span while `forceFlush()` is awaited. The callback then permanently loses its valid parent: `recordedContextIds` is populated too late, and completion deduplication prevents correction. Defer the open-parent fallback until final cleanup, allowing a parent end hook to drain its children first. Add a gated-flush regression where the callback notification precedes invocation end and its context finishes during the flush.
